name: 655 Fourth Street
acresNote: The City's notice of exemption (case 2022-011490ENV, filed Jan 17, 2024): a 71,290 sq ft (1.64-acre) site of seven lots, Assessor's Block 3787, Lots 026, 028, 050 and 161 to 164, which the project would merge.

program.notes: As approved on Dec 14, 2023: one building with a podium and two residential towers, 380 and 400 ft to the roof (405 and 435 ft to the top of the rooftop screens), with about 1,032,500 sq ft of residential space in 1,105 homes (129 studios, 539 one-bedroom, 400 two-bedroom and 37 three-bedroom), 9,857 sq ft of ground-floor retail, a 9,153 sq ft public plaza at the corner of 4th and Townsend streets, and a two-level basement with about 271 parking spaces (284 in the CEQA notice). Planning's pipeline data lists the affordable housing requirement as met by a fee. The 2019 approval for the site (Motions 20470 and 20471) was a different design: two buildings appearing as four towers of 360 and 400 ft, with 960 homes, a 38-room hotel and office space.

developer: Tishman Speyer (project sponsor named in the 2024 CEQA notice)
publicPartners: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection
stageNote: The Planning Commission approved the current two-tower design on Dec 14, 2023, and the approval became final on Jan 17, 2024, when no appeal of its environmental determination was filed. No building permit has been issued; the three site permit applications on file date from 2019 and are for the earlier design.

timeline.event: SF Planning opens case 2014-000203 for a mixed-use project at 4th and Townsend streets.
Planning Commission approves the first design (Motions 20470 and 20471): two buildings appearing as four towers of 360 and 400 ft, with 960 homes, a 38-room hotel and office space.
An appeal of the project to the Board of Supervisors is withdrawn.
Site permit applications for two 40-story towers and their podium are filed with DBI; none has been issued.
The sponsor applies to modify the approval (record 2022-011490) for an all-residential, two-tower design.
Planning Department issues a General Plan Evaluation finding the modified project covered by the Central SoMa Plan EIR.
Planning Commission approves the modified project: a Large Project Authorization for the two towers (380 and 400 ft, 1,105 homes) and conditional use authorization to remove two existing homes.
The approval becomes final with no appeal; the City files the project's notice of exemption (SCH 2024010421).

nextMilestone: Building permits from the Department of Building Inspection for the 2023 design.
summary: Two residential towers, 380 and 400 ft tall, on a shared podium at 4th and Townsend streets, across from the Caltrain station: 1,105 homes, ground-floor shops and a public plaza on the corner. The design, Tishman Speyer's revision of a 2019 approval, was approved in December 2023; construction hasn't started.
